name: Atomized Proliferation
aliases: Atomizing Gaussian Splatting for High-Fidelity Radiance Field
definition: A strategy to enhance geometric precision by constraining Gaussians representing fine details into 'Atom Gaussians' (isotropic spheroids with uniform size) and prioritizing their proliferation to align with scene geometry, followed by pruning to merge large smooth surfaces.
summary: Atomized Proliferation is a 3D Gaussian Splatting training strategy that enhances geometric precision by constraining fine details into uniform Atom Gaussians and using an Edge-Aware Normal Loss to guide optimization.
